name: SumUp Invoices
summary: SumUp Invoices creates invoices and quotes at no charge and takes a fee only when a customer pays online through the payment link. The US page lists 2.90% + $0.15 per online payment and no fee for cash or check.

facts.text: Customers can pay through the link by card, bank transfer, cash, Google Pay or Apple Pay.
Each invoice shows one of four statuses: sent, paid, pending or overdue, with a payment timeline for partial payments.
The page does not say which countries support invoicing, and the page we read is the US version.

plans.name: Invoices

volumeFee.basis: per invoice paid online through the payment link

plans.notes: Unlimited invoices and quotes. No fee for cash or check payments

hiddenCosts: The pricing figures come from the US page; fees outside the US may differ.
